cards.ex: Could you send me the file?
Do you mind if I open the window?
Can I get a receipt, please?
Would it be okay if I leave early today?
Let me know if you have any questions.

quiz.note: Could you + 동사원형 = 가장 무난한 정중 부탁.
Do you mind if + 주어 + 동사. 답은 'No, go ahead'(괜찮아요)!
Can I get ~? = ~ 주시겠어요? 카페·식당 필수.
Would it be okay if + 주어 + 동사 — 허락을 구하는 부드러운 형태.
Let me know if ~ = 필요하면 알려 주세요. 이메일 마무리 단골!

cards.ex: Just to confirm, the meeting is at 3, right?
Would it be possible to move the deadline?
I was wondering if you could review this.
Could you clarify what you mean by 'soon'?

quiz.q: ___ , the delivery is on Monday, correct?
quiz.note: Just to confirm, ~ = 확인차 말씀드리면. 오해 방지의 첫마디.

quiz.q: ___ to get a copy by tomorrow?
quiz.note: Would it be possible to + 동사 — 부담 주지 않는 요청.

quiz.q: ___ you could help me with the report.
quiz.note: I was wondering if ~ = 조심스러운 부탁의 정석. 과거형이라 더 부드러워요.
Does + 시간 + work for you? = 그 시간 괜찮으세요?
clarify + 대상 바로. clarify about은 군더더기!

cards.ex: I'm afraid I can't make it on Friday.
I see your point, but the timeline is too tight.
I'd rather not commit to that yet.
That might be tricky because we're short-staffed.
Could we meet next week instead?

quiz.q: Sorry, ___ join the call today — I have a client meeting.
quiz.note: I'm afraid I can't = 부드러운 거절의 정석.

quiz.q: ___ , but I think we need more time.
quiz.hint: 상대 말을 인정한 뒤 반대 (point 포함)
quiz.note: I see your point, but ~ = 반대해도 관계를 지키는 문장.
I'd rather not + 동사 = 완곡한 거절. no보다 훨씬 부드러워요.

quiz.q: ___ because half the team is on vacation.
quiz.note: That might be tricky because ~ = 거절 이유를 자연스럽게 잇는 틀.

quiz.q: Friday doesn't work for me. ___ Thursday instead?
quiz.note: Could we ~ instead? = 거절 뒤에 대안 제시. 이게 진짜 프로의 거절!
